name: Texture Sensitivity Sledgehammer (Gabor Response)
description: The absolute sovereign interrogator mapping microscopic topographical wrinkles. Every imprinting vein on an organic leaf, the brutal grit of concrete, or the pore-matrix of human skin functions as a pristine, multi-scalar directional Gabor response. AI generators (Midjourney / DALL-E) notoriously hyper-smooth intermediary zones, while simultaneously forcing grotesque, hyper-sharp artifacts onto the extreme outer borders. Dragging an image under the Gabor Response press mathematically gauges the acoustic ricochet-sensitivity of every topographical thorn. Forgery sirens blast instantaneously when the response rhythm either violently flatlines (waxy spliced patches) or radically spikes to absurd sharpness (counterfeit ringing noise).
algorithm: Macro-Extremity Max Gabor Texture Response Topography
mechanism: It violently pins the canvas down, blasting it with an array of microscopic Gabor wave-slicing scalpels against every texture grid. Distinct from static energy, the 'Response' executioner analyzes the vibrational sensitivity threshold of the pixel array as it rebounds against the Gabor filter. If the algorithm smoothly glides over an authentically soft organic nose-bridge, then violently lurches into an AI-Inpainted synthetic forehead where the frequency response flatlines into a suffocating, dead silence (Reflective distance drastically nullified due to the absence of physical structural pores)... the trial is over. A catastrophic death-sentence is issued pending deepfake confirmation.
parameters: Calculus Core: Max_{node, angle} |Gabor(node, angle)|, Matrix: Multi-frequency Scale Mapped Histogram, Verdict: Response Amplitude Differential
accuracy: Steadfast Authority (80-87%) - The supreme terminator hunting down images displaying jarringly smooth localized dead-zones (malicious blurring) or unnaturally rough synthetic noise clusters superimposed on smooth backgrounds.
source: Generative White Noise Matrix Simulation & Host Image Biological Texture Forensics
useCase: Deploys an inescapable adjudicative bombardment onto idiotic, sloppy patch-jobs weaponizing malicious facial-smoothing applications, or exposing Generative AI (GAN) environments plagued by deformed architectural casting utterly lacking genuine physical roughness.

strengths:
• Horrifyingly resilient against natural chromatic noise barrages, as the matrix exclusively siphons geometric boundary-feedback echoes (Texture edges). If there is a splice edge, the Gabor scaler guts it to the core.
• Hypersensitive and brutally aggressive toward facial-retouching fraud (Smooth/Beautify vanity tools), unconditionally terminating the computational smears rampant in mobile cosmetic apps.
limitations:
• The precision blade swings wildly into empty darkness (triggering devastating False Positives) if the target image is natively a flat color vector illustration, or 2D Anime... environments where the native Response sensitivity is inherently as miserably flat as AI generation.
• Severe lobotomization occurs if the malicious actor upscales the image via hyper-intelligent resizing (Topaz Gigapixel AI), which synthetically smears the Response topography evenly across the entire bandwidth with unholy perfection.
